topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing and learning objectives for the lecture on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Principles of innate immune recognition and PAMP/DAMP sensing
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the foundational principles of how the innate immune system distinguishes self from non-self by detecting molecular patterns of pathogens and cellular damage using germline-encoded receptors.

topics.label: Pattern recognition receptor families, signaling, and inflammasome activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine specific pattern recognition receptor systems, their intracellular signaling pathways, and the multiprotein inflammasome complex that processes pro-inflammatory cytokines.

topics.label: Inflammatory cascade execution, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how sentinel cell activation orchestrates immune cell extravasation, lymphatic drainage, and potential progression to severe systemic complications like sepsis.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the passive and active mechanisms that terminate acute inflammation, mediate tissue regeneration, and lead to chronic inflammation or granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing framing and previews the topic of the upcoming lecture.
